crossRefs.note: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled.…
Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on…
to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

translations.web: “Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.
translations.bsb: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
translations.kjv: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD
translations.asv: Blessed is the man that trusteth in Jehovah, and whose trust Jehovah is.
